source_policy: Only genuine user-provided photographs may be identity anchors. Never promote generated images to references.

grooming.hair: Dense natural curly/coily hair; preserve current natural silhouette and hairline; approximately 2 inches on top; compact sides/back; no artificial sharp fade or lineup.
grooming.facial_hair: Natural mustache/goatee/stubble target approximately 1 mm. Face-reference beard length is NOT authoritative.

body.mobility_rule: Mobility references describe posture/equipment only when requested; do not automatically add wheelchair or walker.

generation_rules: Select the closest genuine face-reference angle to the requested camera angle.
Do not redesign, beautify, age, or masculinize the face.
Do not use generated images as identity references.
Generate one candidate at a time when identity accuracy is important.
Prefer pixel-preserving edits when the source face is already correct.
